edits.before: "Parse hunk headers into old and new counters. Context consumes both counters, deletions consume only the old counter, and additions consume the new counter while producing a reviewable location. Reject truncated hunks and parent-traversing paths. The parser is deliberately for text unified diffs; binary patches and combined merge diffs are outside the contract. Wire Python into TypeScript using execFileSync and stdin, never an interpolated shell command."
edits.after: "从差异块头解析旧文件与新文件的行计数。上下文行同时推进两个计数器；删除行只推进旧文件计数器；新增行推进新文件计数器，并产生可审阅的位置。拒绝截断的差异块和向父目录穿越的路径。解析器仅处理文本统一 diff；二进制补丁与合并提交的 combined diff 不在契约内。通过 execFileSync 和标准输入将 Python 接入 TypeScript，不要拼接 shell 命令。"

edits.before: "A replacement stays on the new file line even when the old side removes several lines."
edits.after: "即使旧文件侧删除多行，替换内容仍定位到新文件行号。"

edits.after: "继续前进，在下一次副作用发生前检查边界。 图表范围：此处只演示单条新增行的行号与 dynamic-eval 检查；完整 diff 解析、其余检测规则、候选对象校验和 SARIF 导出由实际程序执行。"

edits.before: "Build explicit static detectors for dynamic eval, shell exec, disabled TLS validation and empty catch handlers. Inspect only added lines. These patterns produce review candidates rather than proof of exploitable behavior. Keeping rule ids stable makes deduplication possible when a later model reviewer reports the same concern."
edits.after: "为动态 eval、shell exec、禁用 TLS 校验和空 catch 处理器构建明确的静态检测规则，只检查新增行。这些模式产生评审候选问题，不能证明存在可利用行为。保持规则 ID 稳定，便于后续模型评审者提出相同疑点时去重。"

edits.before: "The fixture emits a high-severity eval candidate with an exact quote and new-file line 2."
edits.after: "夹具产生高严重程度的 eval 候选问题，保留逐字引文及新文件第 2 行定位。"

edits.before: "Advance to inspect the boundary before the next effect."
edits.after: "继续前进，在下一次副作用发生前检查边界。 图表范围：此处只演示单条新增行的行号与 dynamic-eval 检查；完整 diff 解析、其余检测规则、候选对象校验和 SARIF 导出由实际程序执行。"

edits.before: "Require an existing added-line location and a nonempty exact source substring for every candidate. Reject fabricated files, deleted-line locations, empty quotes and invalid severity values. Merge findings by file, line and rule; keep the stronger severity when reviewers disagree. The quote gate establishes location support, not the truth of a security claim, which still needs review."
edits.after: "每个候选问题都必须对应确实存在的新增行位置，并提供非空、逐字匹配的源码子串。拒绝虚构文件、已删除行的位置、空引文和无效严重程度。按文件、行号和规则合并问题；评审者意见不同时保留更高严重程度。引文校验只能确认位置有证据支持，安全判断是否成立仍需审阅。"

edits.before: "Unsupported candidates stay in a rejected collection; duplicate supported candidates collapse into one finding."
edits.after: "无来源支持的候选保留在拒绝集合中，有来源支持的重复候选合并成一个问题。"

edits.before: "Advance to inspect the boundary before the next effect."

edits.before: "Render a self-contained report with source locations, quoted evidence, severity and message. Escape source text as carefully as prose: a diff can contain executable HTML. Keep external publication outside the tool. The CLI writes review.html locally and prints a machine-readable summary for automation."
edits.after: "渲染自包含报告，包含源码位置、证据引文、严重程度和消息。对源码文本与说明文字同样仔细转义，因为 diff 中可能包含可执行 HTML。工具不负责向外发布。命令行程序在本地写入 review.html，并打印机器可读摘要供自动化使用。"

edits.before: "Open review.html to inspect the anchored finding. The source quote renders as text even when it contains HTML."
edits.after: "打开 review.html 检查已定位的问题。源码引文即使包含 HTML，也会按文本显示。"

edits.before: "Compare JSON syntax and source attribution independently."
edits.after: "分别比较 JSON 语法与来源标注。"

edits.before: "Orchard must return JSON and preserve a source locator. Keep `format-json` and `source-link` as different case ids: they are separate promises to the caller. The cassette hashes the entire case list, including prompts and checks, before comparing runs."
edits.after: "Orchard 必须返回 JSON 并保留来源定位信息。将 `format-json` 和 `source-link` 保持为不同的用例 ID，因为它们分别对应向调用方承诺的两项行为。比较运行结果前，响应记录先对包括提示词与检查项在内的完整用例列表计算哈希。"

edits.before: "Build a set of ids while validating. Validate each check kind before looking up a recorded response."
edits.after: "在校验时构建 ID 集合。查找已记录响应前，先校验每项检查的类型。"

edits.before: "Change only the prompt wording. Why must the previous case hash stop matching?"
edits.after: "只改变提示词措辞。为什么之前的用例哈希必须不再匹配？ 图表范围：固定比较 JSON 与来源子串两项检查，不执行完整用例列表、响应记录哈希及模型配置校验，也不代替实际门禁的阈值和空集检查。"
"无需模型即可为记录输出评分"

edits.before: "A valid JSON response can still omit its source. Score every assertion and retain the individual results so a maintainer can see which promise failed."
edits.after: "有效 JSON 响应仍可能遗漏来源。逐项为断言评分并保留各项结果，让维护者知道哪项承诺未被满足。"

edits.before: "Evaluate the list of checks first, then apply all(). A missing response must not become an empty passing checklist."
edits.after: "先计算检查列表，再应用 all()。缺失响应不能变成默认通过的空检查列表。"

edits.before: "Would lowercasing the response before an excludes check change the contract for API_KEY?"
edits.after: "执行 excludes 检查前先把响应转成小写，会改变针对 API_KEY 的契约吗？ 图表范围：固定比较 JSON 与来源子串两项检查，不执行完整用例列表、响应记录哈希及模型配置校验，也不代替实际门禁的阈值和空集检查。"

edits.before: "The candidate fixes source attribution but replaces machine-readable JSON with friendly prose. Pair case ids before calculating the average: one improvement does not repair another broken interface."
edits.after: "候选版本修复了来源标注，却用友好的自然语言替代机器可读的 JSON。计算平均值前先配对用例 ID：一项改善无法修复另一个损坏的接口。"

edits.before: "Keep model, settings and case hash alongside the responses. The CLI rejects changed model/settings unless you explicitly allow that experiment."
edits.after: "在响应旁保留模型、设置和用例哈希。模型或设置改变时，命令行程序会拒绝比较，除非你明确允许这种实验。"

edits.before: "How would you explain a flat pass rate to the owner of the JSON consumer?"
edits.after: "面对通过率不变的结果，应如何向依赖 JSON 输出的程序负责人解释？ 图表范围：固定比较 JSON 与来源子串两项检查，不执行完整用例列表、响应记录哈希及模型配置校验，也不代替实际门禁的阈值和空集检查。"
"根据明确容限设置发布门禁"

edits.before: "Your release gate is an executable policy. With three cases and one regression, a candidate is blocked even if its other responses improve. Save the JSON and Markdown diff as CI artifacts."
edits.after: "发布门禁是可执行策略。三个用例中有一项回归时，即使其他响应有所改善，候选版本也会被阻止。将 JSON 和 Markdown 差异报告保存为持续集成产物。"

edits.before: "Check that thresholds are finite and the suite is nonempty before comparing numbers. Exit status must agree with the reported decision."
edits.after: "比较数值前，检查阈值是否有限、测试集是否非空。退出状态必须与报告决策一致。"

edits.before: "Which assertion would you add after a real support incident, and how would you keep its recording provenance?"
edits.after: "经历一次真实支持事故后，你会添加哪条断言，又如何保留其响应记录的来源？ 图表范围：固定比较 JSON 与来源子串两项检查，不执行完整用例列表、响应记录哈希及模型配置校验，也不代替实际门禁的阈值和空集检查。"

preservedMachineNotes.multi-agent-code-review-panel: 译注：评审者标识、检测规则、严重程度、状态、模型输入和 JSON 报告字段保留原值；HTML 固定说明已译。评审者 ID 不同并不能证明其判断相互独立，源码引文校验也不等于漏洞已确认。
preservedMachineNotes.postmortem-writer: 译注：JSON 字段、packet.txt 及其中的 SOURCE、IMPACT、DECISION 等凭据标记保留原值，HTML 固定文案与参数帮助已译。input line 的双语标注保留原定位测试契约。页面渲染通过不代表审批人身份已认证，也不保证多个导出文件在写入失败时整体原子提交。
preservedMachineNotes.pr-review-reporter: 译注：规则消息同时进入 JSON、SARIF 和下游评审组，故保留英文原值；页面标题与说明已译。findings 和 rejected 的双语计数保留现有测试契约。这里只核对本地补丁证据，不发布 PR 评论或认证漏洞。
preservedMachineNotes.prompt-regression-tester: 译注：检查类型、状态和发布决策保留机器值。stable_pass 为持续通过，stable_fail 为持续失败，regressed 为退化，improved 为改善；ship 表示放行，block 表示阻止。Markdown 标题和表头已译，样本提示词与响应记录不改写。
